name: EZ solutions
one_liner: Software that gives food and beverage manufacturers and oil and gas operators real-time visibility they do not get from spreadsheets, across inventory, demand, and the plant floor.
description: Operational visibility software for food & beverage manufacturers and oil & gas operators, including cross-border US to Venezuela operations.
buyer: Operations and supply-chain leaders at food and beverage manufacturers and oil and gas operators; plant managers tired of running blind on spreadsheets.
pains: demand surges they cannot see coming
inventory and reconciliation done by hand
no real-time visibility on the plant floor
finding out about a problem only when they run out
proof_points: real-time view of inventory and demand in one screen
automatic reconciliation instead of manual spreadsheets
FSMA 204 traceability records generated as product moves
alerts on demand surges before stockouts happen
visual_cues: a clean live dashboard on a laptop showing inventory and demand
a plant floor with product moving on a line
a phone alert about a demand surge
a shipping container or pallet being scanned
a spreadsheet being replaced by a single clear screen
message_bank: the plant was running blind on spreadsheets, now it is on one screen
you find out about the surge before you run out, not after
traceability is recorded as the product moves, not rebuilt later
mechanism first: see it, then act on it
hooks: the plant running blind on spreadsheets

editorial.required_framing: EZ solutions, not an ERP, not an SAP partner
editorial.notes: Voice is dry, plain, mechanism first. No em dashes, no exclamation points, no AI-sounding phrasing.
